intended_use.summary: Consider exact CEMS EMSR927 observedEventA and notAnalysedA service vectors only as an independent event-exclusion aid in a separately reviewed local ASF stable-reference selection method. Exclude third-party ortho imagery and do not infer that unmapped terrain is unchanged.

sources.name: Copernicus Emergency Management Service Rapid Mapping EMSR927 event and not-analyzed vector layers

evidence.note: Exact public API response SHA-256 88274286b904412a978eac6ef05f107510a3264bcf31e25d2253e13290d00219 identifies EMSR927, AOI numbers, finished product versions, and observedEventA/notAnalysedA layer locators; no vector bytes were fetched.

criteria.note: Activation metadata identity is bound; future intake must bind exact layer URL and bytes.

evidence.note: Official CEMS documentation identifies its Rapid Mapping public activation API and the product-layer fields.

criteria.note: CEMS is authoritative for its own emergency mapping product, not independent proof of complete or field-validated event extent.

evidence.note: The public activation API has sensitive=false and advertises ten target vector-layer JSON URLs for feasible finished products.

A metadata-only HTTP HEAD probe returned 200 and Content-Length 278931; all ten exact target URLs returned HTTP 200 with published response lengths as recorded in the local observation. No body was fetched.

criteria.note: Public anonymous URL availability is established at this timestamp; content, checksum, schema, later uptime, and any rate limits remain unverified.

evidence.note: CEMS grants free service-data access and permits reproduction, distribution, public communication, adaptation, modification, and combination subject to its conditions and attribution; use binds the user to the terms, and third-party information has separate terms.
Official attribution instructions exist for activation and product credits.

criteria.note: Rights are sufficient in principle for CEMS-created service vectors only, conditional on an authorized owner decision to use them under these terms. Proprietary source ortho/COG imagery and mixed product ZIPs are excluded.

evidence.note: The official EMSR927 API reports AOI-specific GRA and monitoring product versions and distinguishes observedEventA and notAnalysedA layers from third-party source-image COGs.

criteria.note: Published product lineage is identified; exact vector content and feature-level provenance remain unverified.

evidence.note: Conditional intake can bind each exact API-advertised layer URL, response length and SHA-256, validate JSON structure, CRS and geometry, and retain append-only non-Git custody before use.

criteria.note: This is a post-acquisition verification plan, not a verified vector checksum or promotion.

evidence.note: Official AOI metadata intersect the approved source and corridor only in AOI01 and AOI02; the activation extent is a bounding rectangle. No vector geometry, independently stable land units, or usable ASF control pixels were tested.

criteria.note: CEMS mapping may conservatively exclude observed impacts, but an unmapped location is not a stable control; 30 independent usable controls are not established.

evidence.note: The public API reports sensitive=false. The proposed use is event-area service vectors, not person-level records; later content still requires safe JSON/geometry validation and non-Git custody.

criteria.note: No account, credential, purchase, or third-party source image is needed for this metadata assessment.

blocking_reasons: Exact service-vector bytes, schema, and feature geometry remain unverified
Published event geometry cannot by itself establish 30 independent stable and usable ASF control windows
Owner has not accepted the CEMS data-use terms or authorized adoption of this distinct source

requires_explicit_authorization: download or retain CEMS service-vector content
use CEMS geometry to select stable controls
read ASF pixels outside previously approved event-only staging
publish or redistribute vectors or derived pixels
